Youth Class
5:00 PM
Youth Focus
Word
Connection
Connection means staying close enough to control, but calm enough to move safely with your partner.

Youth movement
Shoulder-to-Shoulder Drag to Cover Hips
Students will practice moving around their partner, covering the hips, and staying balanced on top.

Class game
Games to Build Connection and Cover the Hips
Games will focus on safe partner movement, hip coverage, balance, and staying connected without grabbing too hard.

Parent cue: after class, ask, “How do you stay connected without squeezing?”
Adult Class
6:00 PM
Adult Focus
Warm-up
2 on 1 Shoulder on Shoulder Drag to Cover Hips
A warm-up movement pattern for dragging the shoulder line, covering the hips, and building top control before the finish.

Adult movement
Side Triangle from Down Block Hands
Use the partner’s defensive hand position to open the side triangle entry while keeping chest pressure and hip control.

Finish or variation
Side Triangle from Knee Drop
Enter the side triangle as the knee drop changes the angle and exposes the head-and-arm connection.

Training cue: cover the hips first, then build the triangle.

Each kid has to keep hold of a prop while grappling. Drop it, and the round ends.
That limits how much they can reach and grab, so they have to move instead. Rotate. Keep the elbows tight. Switch the feet. Recover top position.
The prop also gives the other player something specific to attack. Both kids know the goal, and the round keeps moving while I coach what happens.

Stuck in half guard? Stop yanking your leg. 

  When you try to pry your knee free with leg strength, you twist your joints and drain your stamina. 

  Instead, change the angle: 

 • Drop heavy chest-to-chest pressure and pin both of their shoulders flat to the mat. 
 • Walk your hips backward toward North-South until their leg lock opens from leverage, sliding your foot free with zero muscling.

  When you spend your day on your feet running kitchens, resort counters, or mountain calls, you want training that protects your joints and clears your head.
